title: 2021-07-02 DevOps community Meeting notes

Intro

All

  • Who am I? Team

  • Previous Devops experiences

Notes:

Varying degree of Devops experience. Experience from GitHub Actions workflow, Azure pipelines and Jenkins.

The community will help spread knowledge cross projects and as well be an easy way to reach people that likely can help out.

Things that we want have and learn more about:

  • Faster releases

  • Automation

  • DevOps

  • GitHub actions

  • Gather knowledge and help distribute to the team

  • Migrating to GitHub

  • Infrastructure as code and Terraform

  • Share knowledge

  • Inspiration

  • DevOps culture and mindset at IPEX - define and discuss

  • What comes after you have CI / CD pipeline in place

  • How do we monitor our application health

  • How do we log errors

  • Test strategies to enable higher quality

  • IPEX tools for APM and logging

  • ITSM - support and operate mentioned

Discuss role/format of DevOps community at IPEX

  • Slack channel + Teams ?

  • How often meetings?

  • Topic groups - people interested in topic investigate and present for community (not approve by mgmt yet )

  • Have meeting list as backlog ?

Topic groups: Nothing decided yet. But the idea floated was to have "focus groups" spending some time on topics they are interested in. testing a new tool or setting up monitoring etc. Then providing feedback to the devops community.
It was suggested to have the teams show how their devops setup is working. Both pipeline and perhaps Sentry, APM and other things.

and are currently working on finding a common way to use APM for IPEX. New Relic is currently being evaluated. , and has previous experience with New Relic.
